fn: Hole status: ACTIVE is now called ONGOING, and the two terminated choices are now one: TERMINATED. Holes that were Terminated (Other Reasons) show as TERMINATED, nothing is lost. The status list, the map legends and the status labels all use the new names.
ds: Hole status: ACTIVE is now ONGOING, and TERM (EOH) and TERM (OR) are now one: TERMINATED. Updated everywhere: Holes list headings, the Drillhole register badges and Status filter, HOLE STATUS, the map and 3D legends, Data Checks wording and the help text. Existing holes marked Terminated (Other Reasons) now show as TERMINATED; their note is kept.
